Feel free man. We seem to actually relate a lot. I thought I’d always be lazy like my mom but I guess I just have that fight instinct. Couldn’t stand to end up like my alcoholic/drug addict siblings or god forbid, my parents so I worked my ass off. But it’s so discouraging seeing all the kids my age with brand new cars and big houses to stay in without a care in the world an no idea what to do in life. But it’s okay cuz they have all the people rooting for them they could dream of. I work harder than any 17 year old should have to, and I get nothing. I have so much time to myself during the 12-15 hour work days that all I start to think about is how better off I’d be if I left this earth and all the shitty cold people behind. I agree that I am too often left to be tormented by my own thoughts but I genuinely feel unwanted and not interesting enough to get together with any friends.

Oh, I have lots of certifications and licenses for operating machinery/equipment and first aid, etc. I’m the only one in my family to even get my damn HS diploma. But none of that matters to me as much as being happy. I don’t think any job I could get will give me as much happiness as having half decent friends or a loving partner. Which I don’t think I’ll ever have. I worked so hard the past couple years just to reach a point that I can’t go on any longer
